verdict.rationale: Linear's GraphQL API, SDK, and webhook system (linear-docs-49,53,51) provide the technical means to script bulk changes across issues, and there's a documented bulk import capability (linear-docs-47). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-edit UI, batch mutation endpoints, or AI-agent-driven bulk operation workflow across many items at once.  missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/multi-select UI docs, batch/bulk GraphQL mutations, and any agent or automation example operating on multiple items simultaneously.
